proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4147 explicitly gives Garhwali gauṛī cow and Gujarati gāvṛī affectionate cow in its -ḍa extension. Jambu promotes that extension to the existing node 4147-4 *gāvaḍa-. Western gauḍi/gāvḍi/gavaḍi forms retain the cow stem plus this retroflex extension, with stop versus flap, the av/au sequence and final feminine i preserved. Exact intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open; this is more specific than assigning the unextended cow heading. Exact survey form gavaḍi is preserved.
